VND7 induces sharp switching of root cell identity and that MYB46 is not required for this switch.
VND7 induces a sharp switch to xylem identity in Arabidopsis thaliana roots and that this behavior is generated by four candidate VND7 target genes.

how the plant cell fate is controlled by the transcriptional regulatory network.
the molecular and developmental mechanisms of xylem cell development in Arabidopsis thaliana.
understanding the molecular mechanisms that regulate the differentiation of plant cells, and how these cells contribute to the development and function of plants.

this work demonstrates how a transcription factor initiates a switch behavior that is required for xylem cell terminal differentiation.
this study demonstrates that VND7 is the key transcription factor driving xylem cell specification in Arabidopsis thaliana.
